findings.detail: Extracted fair-value sum exceeds the filing and companyfacts investment anchor; the source separately reports cash-inclusive totals outside Total Investment Portfolio.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The filing's own investment anchor ties to companyfacts at 25,337,420 thousand: the balance sheet reports total investments at fair value of 25,337,420 and the schedule reports Total Investment Portfolio fair value of 25,337,420. The reviewed extract sums fair_value to 26,786,615 thousand, an overshoot of 1,449,195 thousand. Source rows also show cash-inclusive totals are separate from the investment portfolio, so the conservation failure is a real over-inclusion/subtotal leakage defect rather than a bad anchor.
